approvedBy: User explicitly requested designs 1 and 2 replace all original skins
prompt:
Create one extraordinary, production-believable desktop web application UI design image for “LifeAtlas / 生活全图”, edge to edge, landscape 16:10, high resolution with crisp readable Simplified Chinese. This is a functional personal-growth workspace for one person, not a landing page, moodboard or device mockup. Aim for the craft of a superbly designed daily-use product.

Direction “光屿工作台”: luminous cool-white and mist-blue ground, deep ink typography and a precise periwinkle accent. Contemporary Chinese sans typography with confident but compact headings. A restrained pearlescent atmospheric light and a few tiny particles exist only in the distant outer background; all reading surfaces are opaque and very legible. Sophisticated spatial layering and impeccable alignment, not a grid of interchangeable dashboard cards.

Compose a slim left navigation rail and an asymmetrical focused workspace: a concise top orientation bar, then the selected growth topic, a compact current-situation / desired-direction summary, a generous continuous dated reading area, and a quiet narrow right margin for the next experiment. Let a fine chronological thread connect two actual records, giving history visual continuity without metrics. Show enough of the next section to make the screen feel complete and usable. Genuine standard buttons, tabs and controls.

Brand “LifeAtlas” and “生活全图”. Navigation: “今日”, “邮箱整理”, “个人成长” selected, “任务记录”, “偏好设置”. Main heading “个人成长”. Topic “工作与生活的边界”. Summary: “常常先答应别人，自己的安排一再后移。” / “保留协商空间，也给重要的人和事留时间。” Two record excerpts: “2025.10.17” — “临时接到任务，我取消了与家人的约定。” and “2026.10.17” — “先问截止时间，约定周一交付，保留了周末。” Reflection “可靠，也可以包含清楚表达自己的安排。” Next experiment “回应前停一下，先看自己的日历。” Controls “记录经历”, “阶段总结”, “变化过程”, “前后对照”; small “粒子动态” toggle, user avatar, and unobtrusive “设计示例”. These are authored personal observations, never AI conclusions. Let the hierarchy, material and composition feel unusually considered while remaining easy to use.
role: UI composition reference; UI text/controls must be semantic; decorative lake is separate generated asset; no invented photos, counts, account avatars or capabilities
